# What Clinicians Are Not Required to Do {#sec-burden}

This list is an acceptance criterion (IMG-SAMP-100). Reject any process change that brings one of these tasks back to clinicians.

| Clinicians are **not** required to... | Who handles it instead |
|:---------------------------------------|:-----------------------|
| calculate quotas or balance `Refer` / `Not-refer` | Team monitoring (@sec-monitoring) |
| count male/female patients or left/right eyes | Team monitoring |
| enter demographic data already available elsewhere | Approved source metadata, or `Unknown` |
| assign a DR grade (0--4) before Workbench review | The Workbench **Confirm DR Grade** step, later |
| assign lesion labels before Workbench review | The Workbench **Annotation Editor** step, only when needed |
| score image quality numerically | A glance-level Use / Review first / Skip decision |
| choose train/validation/test groups | Not done in this POC (IMG-SAMP-051) |
| complete a per-image selection form | No form exists (IMG-SAMP-101) |
| search for duplicates | Workbench SHA-256 detection plus team review |

: Clinician burden boundaries. {#tbl-burden tbl-colwidths="[56,44]"}

**What the clinician does:** choose a suitable image in normal work, and stage it through the approved process. If unsure, do not invent metadata: choose `Unknown`, skip the image, or ask the coordinator. Everything after that happens in the existing Workbench workflow, which the clinician already uses (*Clinician User Manual*).

**Expected extra effort:** a few seconds per image beyond normal image choice. The only exception is a one-time read of the one-page guide.
